## Personality

Dorothy Gardner is characterized by her slim build and a jolly, somewhat tomboyish demeanor. She is also known for her ardent and impulsive nature.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P32](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0032)_

## History

Dorothy was acquainted with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) and his social circle. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected Roy's proposal, Dorothy informed her that [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) recovered quickly from heartbreak.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P7](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0007), [v3 ch.Weddings P28](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0028), [v3 ch.Weddings P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dorothy.md)

Dorothy becomes intimate college friends with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their time together. She participates in an awkward yet memorable meeting at Patty's Place when her family unexpectedly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) early. Later, Dorothy helps ease Anne's disillusionment after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects her brother by reassuring her that he recovers quickly from heartbreak.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +8 more_

- Friend of — intimate college friends  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P33](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0033), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--phil-gordon.md)

Dorothy is a friend of [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). The two worked together to help smooth over an unexpected and frantic social call when Dorothy's family arrived a day earlier than scheduled. Dorothy later attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) alongside their mutual friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +6 more_

- Friend of — helped smooth over the social call together  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

Dorothy is the sister of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She joins her family on a visit to see [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and his romantic interest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which results in a frantic scramble when they arrive a day earlier than anticipated.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +3 more_

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>
